# NeuraScaleX

> Governed Digital Twin + Intelligence for UK specialist clinicians. NeuraScaleX builds an Ask Page that answers patient questions 24/7 from clinician-approved content only — educational and signposting, never diagnostic — plus Intelligence showing what patients need and what to do next.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://www.neurascalex.com/): Ask Dr You — patient questions answered in your voice
- [Platform](https://www.neurascalex.com/platform): how the Ask Page and Ask Intelligence work
- [Specialist Hub](https://www.neurascalex.com/specialist-hub): live Ask Pages from UK specialist clinicians
- [About](https://www.neurascalex.com/about): founding team and principles
- [Book a demo](https://www.neurascalex.com/demo): thirty minutes with the founder
- [Founding cohort](https://www.neurascalex.com/free-trial): join the founding 20 UK specialist clinicians
- [Contact](https://www.neurascalex.com/contact): get in touch
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.neurascalex.com/privacy-policy): privacy and cookie policy
- [Terms of Service](https://www.neurascalex.com/terms-of-service): terms of use

## Live Ask Pages
- [Ask Deepak](https://askdeepak.neurascalex.com/): Prof. Deepak Ravindran, Pain Medicine
- [Ask Dr Abrar](https://askabrar.neurascalex.com/): Dr Abrar Hussain, Consultant Psychiatrist
- [Ask Dr Cathy](https://askcathy.neurascalex.com/): Dr Catherine Sampa Muyeba, Consultant Psychiatrist

## Notes
- Ask Pages answer only from clinician-approved sources. They do not diagnose, prescribe, or give personalised clinical advice.
- Built for UK private specialist practice. UK-hosted and GDPR-aligned.
- Contact: info@neurascalex.com
